decisions.decision: The day column is transaction_date, with received_date for display only
decisions.why: Only transaction_date is NOT NULL and indexed in both receiving tables, and created_at records the import time for historical rows
decisions.rejected: received_date, which is nullable in both tables, and created_at, which is wrong for imported history

decisions.decision: DS-03 = No and LG-02 = A: no Infor Visual receiver query
decisions.why: RECEIVER_LINE carries no PART_ID and no skid or load identity, so a receiver quantity can only be attributed to a purchase order line, never to a receiving row
decisions.rejected: Building the receiver join and splitting its quantity across skids by proportion

decisions.decision: The source residual is compared against an as-of balance reconstructed from live on-hand minus post-window movement
decisions.why: CR_PART_LOCATION is a live snapshot, so today's on-hand cannot speak for a historical day and a backlog sweep would fail on its first day
decisions.rejected: Live on-hand only, which reduces to the same number for a same-day run but breaks every historical day

decisions.decision: Rows whose saved location is already a destination bucket resolve to Unchanged before the general allocation pass
decisions.why: FR-029 and FR-036 require it, and today's allocate-then-compare order can move a row off a location the material genuinely went to
decisions.rejected: Keeping today's order, which reports a legitimate destination as Updated

decisions.decision: Transfer direction comes from INVENTORY_TRANS.TYPE, not from transaction id ordering
decisions.why: The lower-id-is-source heuristic inverts source and destination whenever the out leg carries the higher id, and the quantity proof would then certify a wrong residual
decisions.rejected: Keeping the id-ordering heuristic and validating afterwards

decisions.decision: The quantity proof reads the integer quantity column
decisions.why: FR-027 and LG-05 fix the field at the integer, which means the module must project quantity and weight_quantity separately instead of collapsing them as Receiving does
decisions.rejected: Reading weight_quantity, which is what today's service does and what C-04 predicts will over-produce unresolved lines

decisions.decision: The grouping key gains the purchase order
decisions.why: Today's part-and-date key merges two purchase orders of one part on one day, which would corrupt every bucket in the group
decisions.rejected: Keeping the part-and-date key and splitting afterwards

decisions.decision: One navigation entry in the shell's Reporting group, opening the module page directly
decisions.why: FR-062 requires the module to appear exactly once, and a separate launcher page would be a second surface to keep labelled
decisions.rejected: A launcher card on the Reporting page, per the UI-01 reading

decisions.decision: The new module ships a Documentation folder per R-DOC-01 rather than a docs folder
decisions.why: The rule is binding, calls the folder a deliverable, and the new module has no legacy shape to preserve
decisions.rejected: Copying the docs folder shape the four older modules use

decisions.decision: FR-054 defaults to any authenticated user with no supervisor gate
decisions.why: The review flow is unaffected either way, and the single write procedure is the one place a later role gate would be enforced
decisions.rejected: Defaulting to deny, which would leave the module unable to perform the correction the request asks for

decisions.decision: The module owns a Visual DAO of its own and loads its query files through the Core query loader
decisions.why: R-MOD-07 forbids a shared DAO while allowing Module_Core as a dependency, and the loader is a helper rather than a DAO
decisions.rejected: Reusing Module_Core's Infor Visual DAO, which would make the two modules share data access

decisions.decision: The proof takes the group's balance input rather than reading Infor Visual itself
decisions.why: It keeps the write gate a pure function that tests can drive directly, while the preview composition still reads the balance the proof consumes
decisions.rejected: Injecting the Visual DAO into the proof, which would have made the correctness centre untestable without a database

decisions.decision: A finding carries a cycle-free proof context instead of a back-reference to its group
decisions.why: Accepting a line must re-run the proof, and a group that holds its findings would form a reference cycle that makes any diagnostic walk infinite
decisions.rejected: Pointing the finding at its group, which caused a stack overflow the moment a test formatted the finding

decisions.decision: Written counts the lines carrying the Updated or Manually Set outcome
decisions.why: FR-021 requires the seven counts to sum to the rows loaded at every moment, including before a line is accepted
decisions.rejected: Counting only lines actually written, which left writable lines uncounted and broke the totals

decisions.decision: A row whose saved location is the group's receiving location and whose residual agrees is Unchanged
decisions.why: FR-031 says material that stayed is legitimate stock, and the receiving location is never a destination bucket because nothing was transferred into it
decisions.rejected: Treating such a row as Not Enough because no bucket covered it

decisions.decision: A stock-wide exclusion build cannot verify the module boundary
decisions.why: Every module compiles into one assembly and the DI extension and shell reference both modules by design, so excluding either folder fails in the shared wiring
decisions.rejected: Splitting the solution into projects, which is a far larger change than this slice authorises

decisions.decision: A group failure and its retry warning name the group through Model_ReconciliationGroupKey.DisplayText rather than the part id alone
decisions.why: FR-069 requires a failure to name the part, the day and the group. Two groups of the same part on the same day were indistinguishable before, so a retry warning could not be traced to the rows that produced it. DisplayText is the module's existing stable identity form and already carries part, purchase order, vendor and day
decisions.rejected: Keeping part id plus date, which passes FR-069's first clause but not the group clause

decisions.decision: The orchestrator tests drive the real group resolver, movement selector, bucket builder, allocator and quantity proof, and fake only the day reader, settings, logger and the Infor Visual DAO
decisions.why: The orchestrator's only job is composition. Faking the pure collaborators would assert that the mocks were called in an order, not that a day turns into correct findings
decisions.rejected: Mocking every collaborator for isolation, which leaves the composition itself unproved

decisions.decision: The no-write case asserts observable state: no finding reaches the Written state and the day stays Previewed
decisions.why: That is what a write would change. Asserting that the constructor takes no write service would restate how the orchestrator is built, and the load model's rows are init-only so they cannot be mutated by any caller
decisions.rejected: A reflection assertion over the orchestrator's constructor parameters

decisions.decision: Attribute the run from the day's selected movement evidence, not from each finding's MovementUserId
decisions.why: Only writable findings carry a per-line user, so a day where every row is unchanged would leave the run attribution empty even though Visual records who moved the material.
decisions.rejected: Aggregating finding.MovementUserId, which under-reports and reads empty on the common unchanged day.

decisions.decision: Give the outcome selector a presentation choice record whose display text is produced by Converter_ReconciliationOutcomeText, behind a leading 'All outcomes' entry, and select it through a derived OutcomeFilterChoice property
decisions.why: The pinned outcome strings stay in the one converter, the filter can always be cleared back to the whole day, and the view model keeps a single copy of the filter state.
decisions.rejected: Binding ComboBox.SelectedValue straight to the nullable enum, which has no place for the pinned text and no way to clear the filter.

decisions.decision: Compile the selector's item template as Mode=OneTime
decisions.why: The choice record is immutable and does not notify; OneWay produced XamlCompiler warning WMC1506 and the build must stay at zero warnings.
decisions.rejected: Making the choice record observable to justify OneWay, which adds machinery for values that never change.

decisions.decision: Reset a failed day through one ClearPage that empties the grid via ApplyFilters
decisions.why: The flat and grouped sources are emptied by the same path a loaded day uses, so they cannot drift apart
decisions.rejected: Clearing GroupedFindings by hand beside Findings

decisions.decision: Log the mixed-unit warning at the top of PreviewGroupAsync
decisions.why: Exactly one warning per group, issued before any early return, and nothing downstream reads the unit
decisions.rejected: Logging after movement selection, which would skip the warning when a group fails early

decisions.decision: Make the launcher view model the IViewModel_HeaderTitleProvider that delegates to ReconciliationHeaderTitleProvider
decisions.why: The shell resolves the page DataContext before the page ViewModel property, so the header is tracked with no MainWindow change
decisions.rejected: Changing MainWindow resolution order, or making the Page itself the provider
